title: US100 Book Profit Service Versus US30 Drawdown Insurance Role

research_height.transfer_path: Cross and Passive lifecycle economics aggregate into the US100 book, then compete with directional drawdown support, fill share and shared capital/slot occupancy as distinct portfolio services.

central_question: Is the US100 Cross-plus-Passive book economically justified primarily as drawdown insurance for the US30 book rather than as a broad positive-return sleeve?

research_bundle.name: book_profit_service_directional_drawdown_service_and_recent_window_falsification
lenses: profit service: pooled and four-period stressed US100 book net plus the independent binding component block
risk service: directional Unit 050 stress-episode offset, explicitly distinguishing US100 protecting US30 from US30 protecting US100
falsification: compare the negative latest window with the broad binding and four-period populations without allowing a recent-window reclassification

idea_provenance.authority_note: The memo supplies only the question and its prewritten strong falsifier. All economic authority and inputs remain inside Project Zeta Terminus Next.

why_now.current_bottleneck: Unit 071 preserved the same-day orientation, so the next capital decision is not an omitted overnight sleeve but whether the high-turnover US100 book supplies profit, protection or neither inside the retained portfolio.
why_now.connection_bridge: The US100 book consumes most binding and latest fills but a minority of binding net, while Unit 050 already isolates directional drawdown support. Combining these roles changes preservation language and any later slot/capital question.
why_now.perspective_distance: Unit 071 was Program 2 meso-to-macro market-path segmentation without strategy conditioning. Unit 072 is Program 5 macro book-service attribution using realized strategy outcomes and directional stress episodes.
why_now.decision_if_insurance_only: Reclassify the US100 book as a protection service and retain exactly one later, separately declared cost-of-cover versus slot/capital question; do not shrink or implement automatically.
why_now.decision_if_positive_return_or_wrong_dir: Reject the insurance-only framing, preserve the existing book, record recent weakness as a bounded window and retain no allocation successor.
why_now.decision_if_ambiguous_or_invalid: Preserve the current book and record only the unresolved role boundary.

whole_map_recomparison.program_1: Unit 070 closed temporally ambiguous and no threshold, direction or 2026-only rescue opens.
whole_map_recomparison.program_2: Unit 071 just falsified overnight dominance; no session-boundary or short-gap rescue opens.
whole_map_recomparison.program_3: Order-type cost and spread-shape cards remain connected to the same-day active window but do not first establish whether the US100 book supplies profit or insurance.
whole_map_recomparison.program_4: Partial-close, mark-clock and ARC-scale cards either need new observation or are adjacent to invalid/closed management paths.
whole_map_recomparison.program_5: Selected because the US100 book's profit-versus-protection role directly controls whether shared capital/slot cost is a premium or productive allocation.
whole_map_recomparison.program_7: Full compounding attribution remains blocked by incomplete binding event paths and no new cross-unit contradiction requires a meta unit.
whole_map_recomparison.after_close: Recompare all programs and heights and continue with one connected, perspective-distant unit. Do not open a US100 allocation, deletion, slot or component variant automatically.

equivalence.role: Independent binding and latest component fill/net blocks only.

unit_050_result.role: Four-period CP2 book economics and both already-frozen directional drawdown-offset variants.

unit_050_closure.role: Semantic authority that US30 protecting US100 passed while US100 protecting US30 failed, with no automatic successor.

evidence_status.note: This unit does not manufacture a new sample. It freezes a decision translation across two independent frozen evidence blocks before executing one deterministic extraction and role classification.

frozen_reconstruction.equivalence_book_net: Sum stressed_2x_net_usd and closed counts for mapped components separately in latest and binding.
frozen_reconstruction.unit_050_profit_service: Use frozen US100_BOOK pooled stressed net and positive-period count; compute per-lifecycle net only as net divided by frozen count.
frozen_reconstruction.directional_semantics: US30_STRESS_US100_COUNTERBOOK asks whether US100 protects US30. US100_STRESS_US30_COUNTERBOOK asks whether US30 protects US100. Do not reverse these labels.
frozen_reconstruction.fill_and_net_shares: Within each equivalence window, US100 closed count and stressed net divided by full-window totals. Signed net share is descriptive and may be negative.
frozen_reconstruction.no_cross_basis_pooling: Do not add or average Unit 050 CP2 lifecycle net with equivalence net. Treat them as independent evidence roles.

profit_service_established: Unit 050 US100 pooled stressed net is positive.
Unit 050 US100 stressed net is positive in at least three of four periods.
Independent binding US100 stressed net is positive.
us100_insures_us30_established: Unit 050 variant US30_STRESS_US100_COUNTERBOOK passed its original frozen gate.
US100 counterbook offset is positive in at least three periods, at least 0.20 in at least three periods, and nonconcentrated under Unit 050.
reverse_direction_established: Unit 050 variant US100_STRESS_US30_COUNTERBOOK passed its original frozen gate.
latest_only_falsifier: Latest US100 stressed net is negative.
Profit service is established on the four-period CP2 and independent binding evidence.
Therefore the latest window cannot by itself reclassify the book as insurance-only.

fixed_verdict_rules.insurance_only: PASS_US100_INSURANCE_ONLY_ROLE_RETAIN_ONE_FUTURE_COST_OF_COVER_QUESTION only when profit service is not established and US100-insures-US30 is established.
fixed_verdict_rules.positive_return_wrong_direction: NO_US100_INSURANCE_ONLY_ROLE_POSITIVE_RETURN_AND_WRONG_PROTECTION_DIRECTION when profit service is established, US100-insures-US30 is not established, and the reverse direction is established.
fixed_verdict_rules.partial: AMBIGUOUS_US100_BOOK_ROLE_NO_CANDIDATE when integrity passes but neither preceding rule applies.
fixed_verdict_rules.invalid: INVALID_US100_BOOK_ROLE_NO_VERDICT when any pin, mapping, arithmetic identity or source semantic fails.

decision_translation.insurance_only: Retain one future cost-of-cover question, but no book change from this unit.
decision_translation.positive_return_wrong_direction: Preserve the US100 book as a lower-yield positive-return sleeve that receives broad US30 protection; reject insurance-only language and retain no successor.
decision_translation.ambiguous_or_invalid: Preserve current construction and rotate away.
